item.text: {"search_note":"Safer than inherited on the narrow nuclear/CBRN side: Akkuyu safety inspection, controlled fuel custody, and expert-heavy CBRN institutions are real gains. Safer on crisis de-escalation in several moments: Erdoğan repeatedly called for ceasefires and restraint on Ukraine and Gaza. More dangerous on the whole: the July 2024 “enter Israel” remark, plus persistent domestic repression and tight media control, mean the overall posture did not clearly improve.
